title: Sprint 4: Voice Notes, Cloudinary Media & Song Embeds
goal: Implement native web audio voice memo recording with waveform preview, multi-photo drag-and-drop uploads via Cloudinary, and song embed integrations for Spotify/YouTube.

issues.title: [Media] In-Browser Voice Memo Recording & Audio Waveform Visualizer
issues.user_story: As a letter writer, I want to record a personal voice note directly from my browser or mobile device, preview its audio waveform, and attach it to my sealed letter.
acceptance_criteria: User can click 'Record Voice Note' to capture microphone audio with real-time waveform visualization.
User can play back, re-record, or delete the voice memo prior to sealing the letter.
Voice recording is uploaded to Cloudinary as an audio resource and linked to the letter's `attachments` array.
Delivered treasure chest view renders a vintage gramophone audio player with scrub bar and duration display.
end_to_end_test_plan: 1. [Media Test] Mock MediaRecorder stream in client -> record 5-second audio snippet -> verify Blob generation.
2. [API Test] Upload audio blob to POST /api/uploads -> verify Cloudinary returns secureUrl and resourceType 'audio'.
3. [UI Test] Seal letter with voice note -> force deliver letter -> open /treasure/:id -> verify gramophone audio player loads and plays audio.
4. [Security Test] Verify that sealed letter audio attachments cannot be accessed before delivery date.
5. [Automated] Add audio upload format and size validation assertions to server smoke tests.

issues.title: [Media] Drag-and-Drop Photo Upload Pipeline & Cloudinary Attachment Manager
issues.user_story: As a sender, I want to drag and drop multiple high-resolution photos into my letter, preview thumbnails with caption notes, and have them securely stored and optimized on Cloudinary.

models: server/src/models/Attachment.js (uploader, letter ref, cloudinaryPublicId, secureUrl, fileSize, format)

acceptance_criteria: React Dropzone supports drag-and-drop of JPEG, PNG, WEBP, and HEIC up to 10MB per file.
Client compresses images before upload for snappy performance on mobile connections.
Uploads show smooth animated progress rings and thumbnail previews with removal buttons.
Delivered letters render an interactive photo grid with a full-screen Lightbox viewer.
end_to_end_test_plan: 1. [API Test] POST /api/uploads with multi-part image -> verify Cloudinary response with secureUrl and auto WebP optimization.
2. [API Test] DELETE /api/uploads/:id -> verify record removed from MongoDB and asset deleted from Cloudinary.
3. [UI Test] Drop 3 images into /write editor -> confirm progress bars and thumbnail previews render.
4. [UI Test] Open delivered letter -> click photo thumbnail -> verify full-screen Lightbox opens with next/previous navigation.
5. [Automated] Validate image upload middleware limits in smoke tests.

issues.title: [Media] Music & Song Embed Integrations (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube)
issues.user_story: As a sender, I want to attach a meaningful song (Spotify track URL, Apple Music, or YouTube link) so the recipient can listen to our soundtrack while reading the letter.

models: server/src/models/Letter.js (song object: { provider, url, title, artist, embedUrl })

acceptance_criteria: User can paste a Spotify, YouTube, or Apple Music link when writing a letter.
System validates URL and extracts the canonical embed iframe URL.
Composer renders a mini music card preview showing song title and provider icon.
Delivered letter reveal page embeds the music player widget at the top of the parchment.
end_to_end_test_plan: 1. [Validation Test] Test songSchema with valid Spotify URL (`https://open.spotify.com/track/...`) and invalid URL -> verify schema validation.
2. [API Test] POST /api/letters with valid song metadata -> verify song object saved in MongoDB.
3. [UI Test] Seal letter with Spotify song -> force deliver -> open /treasure/:id -> verify Spotify embed iframe renders and loads track.
4. [Automated] Add song URL parsing unit test to shared test suite.
